en.title: Abdulnabi's Presidency of Libyan Parliament Deepens Lawmakers' Divisions
en.summary: The election of Saleh Abdulnabi as head of Libya's House of Representatives, succeeding Aqila Saleh, has intensified disagreements within the legislature after several lawmakers rejected the results of the Benghazi session.

stories.title: Belarus cut motor fuel supplies to Russia in September, sources say

en.title: Belarus cut motor fuel supplies to Russia in September, sources say
en.summary: Belarus reduced shipments of gasoline and diesel to Russia by rail in September ahead of refinery maintenance, though supplies remained higher than average monthly levels so far this year.

en.title: Lebanon's Hezbollah Gets $200 million from Iran to Help Displaced
en.summary: Iran has provided $200 million to Hezbollah to assist displaced persons in Lebanon.

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded to Kagan, Soai for Untangling Mirror Images in Molecules
en.summary: Kagan and Soai have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on understanding mirror images in molecules.

stories.title: Lebanon’s Hezbollah gets $200 million from Iran to help displaced, sources say

en.title: Lebanon's Hezbollah gets $200 million from Iran to help displaced, sources say
en.summary: Hezbollah received $200 million from Iran last month to assist Lebanese civilians displaced by the conflict with Israel. The transfer occurred despite US sanctions on Iran and challenges in moving funds to the organization.

stories.title: Kingdom suspends 8 Umrah service providers over unlicensed accommodation

en.title: Kingdom suspends 8 Umrah service providers over unlicensed accommodation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Hajj and Umrah suspended four service companies and four overseas agents for housing pilgrims in unlicensed facilities in Makkah. The cases were referred for investigation and potential penalties.

stories.title: Al-Hammami turns Gulf Cup dream into breakthrough moment with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Al-Hammami turns Gulf Cup dream into breakthrough moment with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Saudi winger Hammam Al-Hammami scored in the Arabian Gulf Cup 27 final against the UAE and was named the tournament's best player, marking a significant breakthrough with the national team.

stories.title: Hajj Ministry suspends 8 Umrah companies and foreign agents for accommodation violations

en.title: Hajj Ministry suspends 8 Umrah companies and foreign agents for accommodation violations
en.summary: The Ministry of Hajj and Umrah suspended four service companies and four foreign agents after detecting violations related to housing Umrah pilgrims in unlicensed facilities. The cases were referred for investigation and penalty proceedings.

stories.title: UAE Strongly Condemns Houthi Terrorist Militia's Continued Targeting of Civilian Assets, Saudi Ships

en.title: UAE Strongly Condemns Houthi Terrorist Militia's Continued Targeting of Civilian Assets, Saudi Ships
en.summary: The UAE has condemned the Houthi militia for continuing to target civilian assets and Saudi ships in the Red Sea region, calling these actions violations of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and security.

en.title: Nobel Prize in chemistry awarded to Kagan and Soai for untangling mirror images in molecules
en.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai have won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their research on mirror image molecules, a discovery with significant implications for pharmaceutical development.

stories.title: UAE strongly condemns Houthi's continued targeting of civilian assets, Saudi ships

en.title: UAE strongly condemns Houthi's continued targeting of civilian assets, Saudi ships
en.summary: The UAE has condemned the Houthi militia's ongoing targeting of civilians and economic assets in Saudi Arabia, including ships in the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab Strait, stating these actions violate Saudi sovereignty.

stories.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal

en.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan spoke by phone with the foreign ministers of Egypt and Jordan, who expressed support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi militia aggression. The ministers discussed strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation between the countries.

en.summary: Leen Alkhair Trading Co. approved a restructuring plan to separate its industrial, agricultural, and logistics operations into a wholly owned subsidiary while maintaining its wholesale and supply sector.
